newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street stocks reebound at open.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street stocks reebound at open.

text.p: Wall Street stocks rebounded from Monday's selloff at the start of trade on some stability in the high tech sector.
The Dow Industrials was up 18 points at 6,824 at the start. The Nasdaq Composite rose seven to 1,342, while the S&P Index was up two at 787
As Wall Street opened the 30-year long bond was off 1/32 to yield 6.71 percent.
